metadata.description: A collection of skills and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: writing-tools
plugins.description: Revise prose for clarity and busy readers, write controlled technical Norwegian, with automatic Vale linting of Markdown files on every edit

plugins.name: learning-tools
plugins.description: Turn text, notes, code, or images into Anki flashcards built on Andy Matuschak's prompt-writing principles

plugins.name: devops-tools
plugins.description: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs on workflow edits, parallelize workflow steps, set up dependency cooldowns and mise toolchains, and analyze skills to split scriptable work from judgment work
